plan.question: Does the observed ordering-by-offset interaction, and the selected scale-half AUC advantage over full own-event and fixed-scale tangent gradients, persist across authorized paired initializations? At seed 42, scale-half AUC is 0.6151021885074872 versus full 0.6149816911798147 and fixed 0.6149888455418249. The chronological adjacent-minus-half contrast is +0.00026890848463556605, whereas inverse-norm-rank adjacent-minus-half is -0.00007708242251203146; their interaction is -0.0003459909071475975. Rank-adjacent has lower Logloss than rank-half, so there is no uniform metric winner. Round 14 reports nonzero mean-BCE product and shared category/brand embedding gradient differences at two training states with equal within-state logits/loss; enabled and disabled audits exactly replay incumbent aggregate metrics. This narrows the earlier supervised-gradient evidence gap but supplies neither an independent seed nor optimizer mediation. Retrieve and verify the existing six-arm comparison lineage and capability/resource prerequisites before proposing further execution. If later authorized, retain full, fixed-0.2 tangent, chronological adjacent/half, and inverse-norm-rank adjacent/half, with unchanged forward, capacity and training recipe. Precommit paired seeds 43/44 and report every admitted complete block, AUC contrasts, interaction, Logloss, counted slices and measured costs. Negative or reversed contrasts weaken the robustness hypothesis; repeated seeds assess robustness rather than provide new mechanism contrasts. Do not extend the donor family or infer temporal/action semantics from these results.
